name: Concept-residual decomposition + rank loss
tagline: Three-channel decomposition (concept proto cross-attention, residual stock-stock cosine attention, individual) trained with concept-co-membership-weighted pairwise rank loss.
formula: $$\mathcal L = \mathrm{MSE}(\hat y, y) + \alpha\,\mathcal L_{\text{rank}} + \beta\,(\overline{h_e\!\cdot\!h_i})^2 + \beta\,(\overline{h_i\!\cdot\!h_{\text{ind}}})^2,\;\; \mathcal L_{\text{rank}} = -\,\overline{\tanh(5\Delta\hat y)\,\mathrm{sign}(\Delta y)\,\big(0.7\,U + 0.3\,W_C\big)}$$

key_hyperparams.name: α (rank-loss weight)
key_hyperparams.role: weight on concept-modulated pairwise rank loss

init_recovers: Plain GRU + MSE when α = β = 0 and the implicit/explicit branches are masked out.
diff_from_baseline: Departs from HIST/GATs by an explicit three-channel decomposition (cross-attention to concept prototypes, then implicit cosine self-attention on the residual, then an individual MLP) and trains it with a pairwise rank loss whose pair weights are 0.7 uniform + 0.3 concept-comembership — a graph-regularized ranking objective.

name: Concept-guided gated GRU
tagline: GRU encoder, concept-attention-weighted aggregation up to concepts then back to stocks, with concept-channel dropout and a sigmoid gate that mixes individual vs. concept-enhanced features.
formula: $$\tilde C = \mathrm{rownorm}(C)\odot(1 + \mathrm{LR}(W_a h)),\;\; \hat C = \mathrm{rownorm}(\tilde C^\top h),\;\; h_g = \mathrm{LR}(W_p\,\tilde C\hat C),\;\; g = \sigma(W_g[h_i\Vert h_g]),\;\; \hat y = \mathrm{Lin}(g\odot h_i + (1-g)\odot h_g)$$

key_hyperparams.name: concept_dropout
key_hyperparams.role: drop rate on concept channels during training

key_hyperparams.name: loss
key_hyperparams.role: training objective combining ranking and regression

init_recovers: GRU + linear when the gate σ saturates to 1 (purely individual) or 0 (purely concept-enhanced).
diff_from_baseline: Vs. HIST/GATs: replaces O(N²) self-attention with concept-bottleneck propagation (stocks → row-normalized concepts → stocks), adds a per-stock learned concept-attention modulator and concept-channel dropout, and fuses individual vs. graph-enhanced branches via a sigmoid gate.

name: Dual-graph GNN (TF-IDF + cosine)
tagline: Two-layer GNN with two adjacency matrices: TF-IDF-weighted symmetrically-normalized concept graph plus dynamic cosine-similarity feature graph, residual-blended.
formula: $$A = C\,\mathrm{diag}(\mathrm{idf})\,C^\top + I,\;\; S = D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2},\;\; \tilde A = \mathrm{softmax}(5\,\hat h \hat h^\top),\;\; h^{(k+1)} = \mathrm{LN}\big(h^{(k)} + \mathrm{GELU}(S\,W^{(k)}_s h^{(k)} + \tilde A\,W^{(k)}_d h^{(k)})\big)$$

key_hyperparams.name: stock_embed dim
key_hyperparams.role: stock identity embedding concatenated at head

diff_from_baseline: On top of GATs/HIST: builds a TF-IDF-weighted, symmetrically-normalized concept graph S as a static GNN adjacency, and adds a parallel dynamic cosine-similarity adjacency Ã; both are used at every GNN layer (residual + GELU + LN), and a per-stock embedding is concatenated at the head.

name: LightGBM + concept low/high-pass + ridge calibration
tagline: Augments LightGBM features with concept-graph low-pass and high-pass projections + concept degree, then calibrates LGB residual via concept-smoothed predictions and ridge.
init_recovers: Plain LightGBM on raw Alpha360 features when the concept low/high-pass branch and ridge correction are zero.
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of the lgbm baseline with a graph component: appends concept-graph low-pass / high-pass projections (and degree/idio aux features) to the LightGBM features, then learns a small ridge residual calibrator over (concept-smoothed − base, degree, idio) — concept-aware boosting without going to a GNN.

name: Pretrained-LSTM + concept-bottleneck GNN
tagline: LSTM encoder warm-started from the qlib pretrained LSTM, then 2 layers of concept-mean → linear → scatter-back with sigmoid gate fusion and LN.
formula: $$\bar C^{(k)} = \frac{C^\top h^{(k)}}{\sum_i C_{ic} + \varepsilon},\;\; \hat C^{(k)} = W_c^{(k)} \bar C^{(k)},\;\; h_g^{(k)} = W_s^{(k)} (C\hat C^{(k)}),\;\; g = \sigma(W_g[h^{(k)} \Vert h_g^{(k)}]),\;\; h^{(k+1)} = \mathrm{LN}(h^{(k)} + g\odot h_g^{(k)})$$
init_recovers: Pretrained-LSTM baseline at gate g→0 (no graph contribution).
diff_from_baseline: Departs from GATs/HIST self-attention: implements concept-bottleneck propagation (stock→concept mean→linear→stock scatter) over two layers with a learned sigmoid gate residual+LN at each layer, started from the qlib pretrained LSTM weights for the temporal backbone.
